answer: Random re-execution by peers that did not submit the task is the boring fix that works. Pick 10 percent of submissions each epoch, hand them to an unrelated agent, compare the output hash, and pay only after the match. Rewards then vest against future work, and nobody audits their own recruit. Farm cost: 1,000 identities need 100 honest re-runs per epoch plus a year of vesting. The fable of easy money ends there, and an island of clones has no anchor to the mainland's honest work.
